question: कच्छ अजरख के लिए पानी क्यों मायने रखता है?

sentences.text: पानी की आपूर्ति में लोहा होने से अंतिम रंग फीके और गहरे पड़ जाते हैं; फिटकरी, टिन या क्रोम के जमाव रंगों को चमकाने में मदद करते हैं।

citations.quote: Water enriched with alum, tin or chrome mineral deposits will help brighten the colors but presence of iron in the water supply dulls and darkens the final result.
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 8

sentences.original: Presence of iron in the water supply dulls and darkens the final result; alum, tin or chrome deposits help brighten colours.

sentences.text: अजरख की छपाई वहीं केंद्रित हुई जहाँ अतिरिक्त नरम पानी उपलब्ध था।

citations.quote: The district gazetteers of 1971 have mentioned that Ajrakh Printing-Ajrakh is another popular variety in hand-printing of textiles in Kutch. Ajrakh printing originally came from Sindh and got concentrated where extra soft water was available.
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 3

sentences.original: Ajrakh printing got concentrated where extra soft water was available.

sentences.text: Excess iron in groundwater threatened Ajrakh in Dhamadka and is again threatening it in Ajrakhpur.

citations.quote: Excess iron in groundwater that threatened Ajrakh in Dhamadka, is once again threatening the craft in Ajrakhpur.
